notes: Every regular file under each named final evidence folder is preserved, including failed/setup attempts, source capsules and harness outputs.
Borrowed links are recorded without copying installed dependencies.

Literal .git path components in synthetic Docker fixtures are stored as __literal_dot_git__ to satisfy Git path rules. Original relative/full source paths remain in every manifest record; bytes are unchanged, and encoding collisions are refused.
This manifest does not hash itself. Committed/index verification is a separate receipt.
